faqs.answer: The clinic is opposite the free car park at 90 Horsefair Street, Charlton Kings, Cheltenham, GL53 8JR. Head down the side of the building to reach the entrance and reception.
There is free parking in the car park directly opposite on Horsefair Street, but no onsite parking. There is also on-street parking on Horsefair Street.
If you are nearby, the clinic can often accommodate drop-ins and will do its best to help.

questions: How long is a physiotherapy appointment?
How long does a session last?
faqs.answer: The first appointment lasts 45 minutes. Standard follow-up sessions last 30 minutes.

The first appointment is £85 (45 minutes). Standard follow-up sessions are £55 (30 minutes). Pre-paid Buy 5, Get 1 Free packages bring physio sessions to £45.83 each; the team will discuss this at your assessment.

questions: What do I bring to my appointment?
faqs.answer: Wear something comfortable that lets you move easily. For lower back, hip, knee, ankle or foot problems, bring shorts. For neck, upper back, shoulder or elbow problems, a t-shirt or loose top helps.

questions: How many sessions will I need?
How many appointments do I need?
faqs.answer: There is no fixed number because everyone's needs differ, but it is likely you will need at least 4 treatment sessions. Treatment is agreed with you and reviewed at each session.

questions: Do you treat patients covered by medical insurance?
faqs.answer: The clinic is registered with most major health insurance companies. If you are unsure whether your insurer is included, call 01242 303305 and the team will check.

questions: Can you refer me for an X-ray, MRI or scan?
Do I need a GP to get a scan?
faqs.answer: If the team thinks imaging is relevant, they can refer you directly for a private scan or X-ray. You do not need a GP to authorise it.
Appointments cancelled with at least 24 hours' notice are not charged. With less than 24 hours' notice, up to 100% of the fee may be charged, and a missed appointment may be charged at the full rate.

questions: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.answer: Appointments can be booked online, by telephone, by email or in person. The clinic's phone number is 01242 303305.
Payment is due at the time of treatment unless otherwise agreed. The clinic accepts major debit and credit cards and other payments as advertised on its site.
The clinic does not provide emergency medical services. In a medical emergency, contact the emergency services or seek immediate medical attention.

questions: How quickly do you reply to messages?
How long until I hear back?
faqs.answer: The clinic says it aims to reply to messages within 24 to 48 hours.
